verdict.rationale: Brave's pricing page states that developers get up to $20 in free calls every month on prepaid credits with no subscription, and the quickstart says a key can be created and called within minutes. Community discussion confirms a free tier exists but reports its Terms of Use prohibited using responses for AI inference, which could limit agent prototyping. missing for 10: documented free-tier quotas and rate limits, clarity on whether the free credits are allowed for AI/LLM use cases, independent hands-on confirmation of prototyping on free credits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype against the API on a free tier or free credits
